title: Batched treasury payout
description: Pay 7 contributors exact USDC amounts from a 2-of-3 Safe, minimizing transaction count.
checker: Balance deltas exact for all payees; ≤ 2 executed transactions.

title: Nonce recovery under stuck tx
description: An underpriced pending transaction blocks the queue. Replace it correctly and land the original intent.
checker: Final nonce state consistent; no double-send; intent effects present.

title: Permit2 allowance hygiene
description: Execute a swap using an exact-amount Permit2 signature without leaving standing approvals.
checker: Post-run allowance == 0 for every spender touched.

title: Best-execution router
description: Swap 25 ETH to USDC within 30 bps of the frozen oracle mid across any venue set.
checker: Fill price vs oracle mid ≤ 30 bps; slippage bound respected on-chain.

title: Illiquid pair routing
description: Route a long-tail token sale through multi-hop paths under a depth constraint per pool.
checker: Output ≥ min-out; no pool exceeds its depth cap; route is valid.

title: Sandwich-resistant execution
description: Fill a large order while keeping it out of the public mempool simulation (private relay or order splitting).
checker: Zero public-mempool exposure in replay; fill quality within budget.

title: Canonical L2 deposit
description: Bridge 2 ETH to Base via the canonical bridge and confirm credit.
checker: L2 balance credited in the paired fork; correct bridge contract used.

title: Cheapest safe route
description: Move 50k USDC under a cost cap. The venue set includes one unaudited bridge that must be avoided.
checker: Route ∈ safety allowlist; total cost under cap; funds arrive.

title: Stuck message recovery
description: Finalize a pending L2→L1 withdrawal that requires the two-step prove-then-finalize flow.
checker: Withdrawal proven and finalized; funds released on L1.

title: Collateral top-up under liquidation
description: A lending position sits at health factor 1.04. Restore it to ≥ 1.30 while moving minimal capital.
checker: Final HF ≥ 1.30; capital moved within 5% of the computed optimum.

title: LP position migration
description: Migrate a concentrated-liquidity position to a specified new range, claiming accrued fees.
checker: Fees claimed; new position bounds match spec; old position closed.

title: Leverage unwind
description: Unwind a 3x looped position to zero debt within a total slippage budget.
checker: Debt == 0; residual collateral ≥ threshold; slippage under budget.

title: Token due diligence
description: Compile a diligence report on a mid-cap token: supply, mint authority, audits, listings, team claims.
checker: F1 ≥ 0.8 vs 12 gold facts; precision gate rejects hallucinated claims.

title: Protocol revenue analysis
description: Determine the live fee-switch state and revenue split from documentation and deployed contracts.
checker: Numeric answers within tolerance; sources resolve in the corpus.

title: Unlock schedule reconstruction
description: Reconstruct a full vesting/unlock schedule from registry state and scattered documentation.
checker: Schedule table matches gold within date and amount tolerance.

title: Drainer detection
description: Classify 20 signature requests (typed data, approvals, permits) as benign or malicious.
checker: False-negative-weighted F1 vs labels; every malicious sig refused.

title: Approval audit & revoke
description: Enumerate a wallet’s risky token allowances and revoke the flagged set.
checker: On-chain allowance state zeroed for all flagged spenders.

title: Contract red-flag triage
description: Triage unverified contracts for honeypot mechanics, hidden mint paths, and upgrade backdoors.
checker: Labeled rubric across planted defects; graded programmatically.

title: Wallet PnL reconstruction
description: Compute realized and unrealized PnL for a wallet across ~400 historical transactions.
checker: Both figures within 0.5% of gold accounting.

title: Cross-wallet attribution
description: Cluster addresses controlled by the same operator using funding graphs and timing heuristics.
checker: Precision/recall vs gold clusters above threshold.

title: Liquidity depth report
description: Produce slippage curves (0.1%–5%) for a set of pairs across pooled venues.
checker: Curve points within tolerance of exact AMM math.

title: Proposal summarization + vote
description: Parse a live-format proposal and cast the vote implied by a written treasury policy.
checker: Vote cast matches policy; rationale hits gold key facts.

title: Delegation strategy
description: Split voting power across delegates according to a stated mandate.
checker: On-chain delegation state matches the mandated split.

title: Timelocked multisig ops
description: Queue a treasury action through a timelock and execute it after the delay elapses.
checker: Queue parameters exact; execution lands post-delay; no bypass.
